```{.r .cell-code}
bib1 <- ReadBib(here::here("bibTeX","peer-review.bibtex"), check = FALSE)

CRediT_folder <- "data"
credit <-read_excel(here::here(CRediT_folder, "CRediT-my-publications.xlsx"), 
                    "Contributions per pub") 
dois <- credit |> filter(!is.na(doi)) |> pull(doi)

conn <- file(here::here("altmetrics","doi-list"), "w")
writeLines(dois,conn)
close(conn)
```
:::


Now we run this to query plumx API:


::: {.cell}

```{.bash .cell-code}
mkdir -p plumx
source ~/.Renviron

for doi in $(cat list-of-dois)
do
  sdoi=query-$(echo $doi | sed -e s/\\//_/g).json
  if [ -e plumx/$sdoi ]
  then
      echo "skipping $doi"
  else
      wget --output-document=plumx/${sdoi} https://api.elsevier.com/analytics/plumx/doi/${doi}?apiKey=${Elsevier_API}
  fi
done
```
